summary: Check my logged-in web accounts for anything urgent, summarize it, and draft (but do not send) any replies that need my attention.
note: Delivered by briefing triage: POST /briefing/triage reads across the owner's mail AND their logged-in web accounts under the interruption policy, says only what actually needs them, and leaves everything else as findings in a review queue at GET /briefing/review, settled one at a time by POST /briefing/review/:id. It never replies, sends or archives. Modules local-agent/briefingTriage.js + briefingQueue.js (briefingTriage.test.js), wired by registerBriefingTriageRoutes(app) at local-agent/server.js:1406; reachable by voice as the planner-advertised action types briefing_triage and review_queue. Surviving id for the "check my logged-in accounts, tell me only what is urgent, draft but do not send" cluster.
